title: Gamma conjecture II and explicit Stokes data for a quadric projective bundle
summary: We study the connection problem for the quantum differential equation of the Fano fourfold $X=\PP_{Q^3}(\OO\oplus\OO(1))$. The problem is to identify its canonical asymptotic solutions with exceptional objects and compute the associated Stokes data. We use exact Mellin--Bessel integral representations and uniform vector asymptotics on sectors wider than $π$, followed by analytic continuation that preserves the Gamma framing.
